TO-BE — Layaways with the shop app and n8n

Target operating process, not evidence that local workflows are published. Blue: automation; orange: app; white: people. HU-08 and HU-14 are integrated in dev (checked 2026-10-28). Telegram assistants and new input flows are outside this map.
Customer emails require consent: confirmation, payment receipt,
collection notice, reminders and voucher. Missing email uses
the shop follow-up path. The initial payment can settle the
HU-14: unauthorized requests are rejected; customer messages require consent
via 09. Unreadable consent register blocks sends and raises an error. Flows
01/02 use app amounts. Flow 04 uses a configurable threshold. Router ignores
apartado.vencido: 06b owns voucher notices. Unknown events are ignored.
Not a payment: ignore. Invalid, ambiguous, unknown, overpaid or overdue: no
registration; ask/notify Marisa. Uncertain POST result: stop and reconcile
before retry. Confirmed payment => normal app event => receipt via 02, never a
One history row per date. Bizum totals include transfers. Manual reruns default
to no email. Movements after 23:55 need recalculation of their original date;
they do not automatically enter the next date's close.
No voucher receipt from the router. Once expired, the reservation is no longer
selected. Failed customer email requires human follow-up; state change alone
does not prove successful delivery. A manual app expiry does not trigger the
HU-08 integrated in dev; publication is a separate authorization. Settlement
month uses latest payment among currently settled reservations (no
fecha_liquidacion). Expiry month uses voucher date. Debt is current, not
Local Error Workflow association is required. Manual editor failures do not invoke it. If the alert email also fails,
inspect n8n execution history; this map does not claim a second alert channel.

Scope: operational layaway map and supporting summaries, not a node-by-node workflow export. No new financial records are created by reports. API business rejections are handled explicitly; unexpected failures go to configured Error Workflow 08. A webhook may be lost: app events are sent
once without retries; schedules query the API independently.
